Carriages travel through them.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Hess'irolia'nuruodo]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]|<ref name="Force Heretic II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>}}
The '''iceways''' was a series of underground travel routes excavated on the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]]. Boring through the bedrock of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the iceway was unaffected by the shifting ice on the surface. Specialized carriages moved passengers and cargo through the tunnels.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Csilla is&hellip; as it always is. Beautiful and frigid. Walking the iceways, one almost forgets the Ruling Family disputes, the House Paiiri collapse&hellip;|Aristocra Saganu|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The iceways of Csilla were to be mentioned in the 2011 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', but the dialogue was cut before release.
